sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Certified Good Distribution Practice (GDP) Clinical Logistics

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France has a comprehensive network of bilateral investment treaties (BITs) and double taxation avoidance agreements (DTAAs) with over 100 jurisdictions; active treaties include the France-Germany BIT, France-UK DTA, France-USA DTA, EU-wide free trade and investment agreements through the EU framework such as CETA with Canada and the EU-Japan EPA.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: France: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L. 561-1 to L. 561-59-2 and Articles R. 561-1 et seq., implementing EU AML directives; Loi n° 2016-1691 of 9 December 2016 (Sapin II) on transparency and anti-corruption; Décret n° 2018-1054 of 29 November 2018 creating the beneficial owners register (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs, RBE), administered by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) and the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the constitutional documents of each UBO (e.g., certificate of incorporation, articles of association, seat certificate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry, notary, or public registrar in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille Convention (Convention du 5 octobre 1961), through the competent authority of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of each individual UBO's full valid passport or national identity card
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary, public official, or competent consular authority in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Powers of attorney for the incorporation agent (mandat)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or authorized legal representative in country of origin; if executed in France, an avocat or notaire must notarize
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille Convention, or Consular Legalization for jurisdictions not party to the Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Unofficial English or French translation of any non-French document, certified by a sworn translator
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Judicial translation expert (traducteur agréé) listed with the Cour d'appel in France
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Not subject to apostille (certification by translator coupled with apostilled original where required)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP and sanctions screening is conducted against (i) French and EU consolidated lists maintained by the Direction Générale du Trésor and the EU Official Journal (EU Regulation 269/2014 and 2580/2001, as amended); (ii) United Nations Security Council sanctions; (iii) OFAC SDN List for correspondents; (iv) the French national financial intelligence unit TRACFIN guidance; and (v) the Database of the Registre National des Entreprises. All UBOs and directors must be screened on incorporation and upon any change, with a documented risk waiver evidentiary file retained for 5 years under CMF Article L. 561-5.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI), in coordination with the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) and the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via the Greffes des Tribunaux de Commerce.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All statutory corporate documents, including the articles of association, are required to be in French language as provided by Loi n° 94-665 of 4 August 1994 (Loi Toubon) and CMF Article L. 123-1. The corporate name (dénomination sociale) must be written in Latin script; if the proposed name includes a foreign transliteration, it must be accompanied by an official French transliteration approved by the registry to ensure unambiguous identification.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Agréé par le ministère de la Santé
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a rejection notice issued by the INPI/RNE registrar through the Guichet unique, the applicant has 15 calendar days to request rectification of factual errors or submit a new name. An administrative appeal may be lodged within 30 calendar days of the rejection notice before the director of the INPI via formal reference ID, supported by arguments remonstrating against the grounds of rejection and any prohibited-token opinion. If the rejection subsists, judicial recourse is available against the decision to the President of the Tribunal Judiciaire/Tribunal de Commerce (competent court of the provisional registry) in accordance with Article R. 123-118 of the Code de Commerce; the appeal must be made by written application and set down within 15 days of the final administrative refusal, or in matters of ministerial approval, by direct formal demand to the competent superintending Ministry (e.g., Ministry of Health for a health-related name).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office service in France is acceptable only in the sense of a shared administrative office with a physical French seat, leased as the registered office (siège social). A pure mail-forwarding arrangement or a mere virtual address with no physical presence is not permitted for a SARL engaged in regulated GDP and pharmaceutical freight activity. The registered office must be a real physical premises in France, and for GDP pharmaceutical freight, a separate operational facility licensed as a wholesale distribution / Good Distribution Practice (GDP) warehouse under applicable pharmacovigilance rules may be required by the French Agence Nationale de Sécurité du Médicament et des Produits de Santé (ANSM). The registered office may be established at the legal representative's residence on a temporary and justified basis for a maximum period of one year, extendable by court order.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Statutory registration filing fee to the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) via the Guichet unique
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official regulatory tariff (taxe d'innovation and formalite filing tariff)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RCS incorporation filing and legal publicity fee (including registration in the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Infogreffe
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariffs established by the Ministerial Order of 18 June 2019

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting and notarization of the articles of association (statuts) if real property contribution is made; otherwise standard non-notarized draft fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Avocat (French Lawyer) or Notaire as applicable
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; statutory notarial fee if applicable for a contribution of immovable property

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UN/UFO and PEP/sanctions screening and enhanced due diligence verification for all UBOs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance service provider and/or French law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional fee schedule for KYC/AML professional services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and notarization bundle for corporate documents and passport copies of foreign UBOs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority in foreign jurisdiction and notarial fees
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Apostille Convention certification tariff plus notary fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn translation of non-French constitutional documents into French
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Judicial translation expert (traducteur agréé) and/or certified linguist
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule for court-appointed translators, scaled by document word count

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name search and preliminary trademark/name clearance report through INPI and Infogreffe databases
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI and/or French intellectual property law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market fee for a professional name and mark conflict opinion

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office address for 12 months (physical shared administrative office under provisions of the Commercial Code)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a low-risk standard-grade shared office

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L. 223-1 et seq. (SARL formation and governance), including Articles L. 223-2 (capital), L. 223-7 (cash contributions and payment), L. 223-18 (management), and R. 123-1 et seq. (commercial register formalities). Beneficial-ownership filing is governed by Articles L. 561-46 et seq. of the Monetary and Financial Code.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The competent local clerk of the commercial court (greffe du tribunal de commerce), through the national business formalities portal operated by the National Institute of Industrial Property (INPI), the Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Online declaration of business creation (formulaire M0 SARL, transmitted through the Guichet unique), supporting the company's registration in the Registre national des entreprises (RNE) and, where applicable, the Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital applies; capital must be stated in the articles. At least one-fifth of cash contributions must be paid at formation, with the balance payable within five years after registration. Cash contributions must be deposited before registration with an authorized bank, notary, or Caisse des dépôts et consignations; the deposit is released after the company is registered. Contributions in kind are generally fully paid at formation and may require a commissaire aux apports, subject to statutory exemptions.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company accepts the subscriptions for the shares set out in the approved articles of association and acknowledges payment of the required portion of each cash contribution, subject to receipt of the deposit certificate. RESOLVED, that the registered office is established at [full address] and that the manager is authorized to complete the related filings. RESOLVED, that [name] is appointed gérant for an indefinite term, effective upon registration, and is authorized to represent the Company within the powers conferred by law and the articles. RESOLVED, that the manager shall complete registration, beneficial-ownership declarations, tax and social registrations, and all ancillary formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Approve the articles and appoint the manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founders and appointed gérant; no government filing window is required for internal approval.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Set the company name, registered office, corporate purpose, term, capital, share allocations, management provisions, and financial year. Execute the articles by all shareholders or their authorized representatives. Obtain any required certified translations and apostilles or legalization for foreign corporate documents and powers of attorney. Appoint the gérant in the articles or by a separate written decision.
required_dossiers: Foreign shareholder corporate documents and authority evidence, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct inconsistencies between the articles, identity evidence, and filing data; obtain missing translations, certifications, or authority documents; re-execute amended documents where required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized French bank, notary, or Caisse des dépôts et consignations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a formation deposit account and transfer the subscribed cash capital, ensuring at least one-fifth of each cash contribution is paid before registration. Obtain the certificate of deposit and retain evidence of each shareholder's contribution. Do not release the funds for company use until registration and delivery of the registration evidence.
required_dossiers: Source-of-funds information requested by the depositary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Resolve identity, source-of-funds, or transfer mismatches with the depositary; amend the subscription schedule if necessary; obtain a corrected deposit certificate before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized legal-announcement publication service (service de presse en ligne habilité or journal d'annonces légales) in the department of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the prescribed formation notice, pay the applicable tariff, and obtain the publication attestation. Ensure the notice matches the articles on company name, legal form, capital, registered office, purpose, duration, and manager details.
required_dossiers: Executed articles or confirmed article data
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request correction or republication if the notice contains material discrepancies; upload the corrected attestation with the registration application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the company creation and beneficial-ownership declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises, with processing by the competent commercial court clerk and relevant authorities.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the online SARL creation declaration and beneficial-ownership information through the Guichet unique. Upload the signed articles, deposit certificate, publication attestation, registered-office evidence, manager declarations, and identity documents. Pay the portal-calculated registration and beneficial-ownership charges. Monitor the portal and respond within the stated deadline to requests for correction.
required_dossiers: Manager identity document and non-conviction and parentage declaration, as applicable
Powers of attorney and foreign corporate documents, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Use the Guichet unique correction workflow to provide missing or corrected documents. If rejected, cure the stated defect and resubmit; seek review from the competent registry where a formal registry decision is disputed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete post-registration corporate and tax setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique, the relevant tax office (Service des impôts des entreprises), and the company's depositary bank.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the RNE/RCS registration evidence and SIREN/SIRET and APE identifiers. Provide registration evidence to the depositary to release formation funds. Maintain statutory registers and accounting records, confirm the company's tax regime and VAT position with the tax office, and register for applicable employer and social-security obligations before hiring.
required_dossiers: Registration extract or equivalent RNE/RCS evidence
Employer and payroll information, if hiring
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct registry or tax account data through the relevant portal or office; provide the registration evidence and supporting documents to the bank and authorities; make required declarations before commencing regulated activity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: There is no single general industrial licensing board for ordinary freight logistics in France. For medicinal-product wholesale distribution, the competent authority is the French National Agency for Medicines and Health Products Safety (Agence nationale de sécurité du médicament et des produits de santé, ANSM). For road haulage, the competent regional authority is the DREAL (Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement), or the relevant DRIEAT in Île-de-France.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Wholesale distribution of medicinal products requires ANSM authorization to open and operate a pharmaceutical establishment (autorisation d'ouverture d'un établissement pharmaceutique) where the company performs activities falling within the statutory wholesale-distribution regime. A logistics or freight operator that does not buy, sell, or otherwise conduct regulated wholesale distribution is not automatically subject to that authorization, but must meet applicable contractual and GDP requirements. Road carriage for hire or reward may require registration in the road-transport register and a community licence, subject to the applicable vehicle and activity rules.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for Ecological Transition (Ministère de la Transition écologique); the competent prefectural authority and regional environmental authority (DREAL or DRIEAT) administer applicable environmental procedures.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: No general EIA classification can be assigned without facility details. A standard logistics warehouse is not automatically subject to a full EIA; installations may require ICPE registration, declaration, or authorization depending on activity, storage quantities, and applicable nomenclature thresholds. An environmental impact assessment is required only where the applicable screening rules or project category require it.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: There is no universal facility-specific wastewater or VOC threshold for this business scope. Comply with the applicable ICPE order and prefectural requirements, sewer-operator discharge consent, French water and waste rules, and any permit-specific emission limits. Segregate and transfer hazardous pharmaceutical or chemical waste through authorized channels; retain required traceability records. Determine ICPE status and any applicable threshold from the actual stored products, quantities, equipment, and site design before fit-out.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Before occupation, confirm planning and building approvals, fire-safety obligations applicable to the building's use and any ICPE status, and required fire systems and evacuation arrangements. Obtain structural and floor-load verification for racking and stored goods from a competent professional. Comply with the Labour Code, risk assessment and single occupational risk assessment document (DUERP), workplace safety requirements, and occupational-health obligations. Obtain any required municipal or prefectural opening approvals; no universal separate workplace clearance applies to every warehouse.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – portal: impots.gouv.fr; business registrations via formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Register the French SARL or branch through the formalities portal; DGFiP generates SIREN/SIRET and the intra-Community VAT number (numéro de TVA intracommunautaire) with the local SIE; a non-EU parent may require a fiscal representative when no permanent establishment exists.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election; available elections: group fiscal integration (intégration fiscale) for 95%-owned subsidiaries, option for family SARL transparency under CGI art. 239 bis AA, and specific advance-investment incentives requiring DGFiP approval. Hybrid mismatch rules under ATAD apply.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Franchise en base de TVA: EUR 85,000 for goods, EUR 37,500 for services; non-EU suppliers generally require registration from the first taxable transaction unless a simplified OSS mechanism is available.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing reform for B2B domestic transactions from 1 Sep 2026 (large and mid-size) and 1 Sep 2027 (SMEs), with real-time reporting via the PPF portal and certified PDPs; export clearances require the DELTA electronic customs system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically dispatched to a non-EU destination supported by transport evidence; intra-Community supply to a purchaser holding a valid French or EU VAT number; services directly connected to export transport and ancillary services exempt under CGI art. 262 and 263.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Insufficient or fraudulent export evidence triggers reclassification of VAT as taxable, retroactive recovery up to 6 years (10 years for fraud), plus an 80% penalty for inexact declarations or abuse of law, and 100% for dissimulation of activity.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France) as the central bank and monetary authority; Direction Générale du Trésor (Treasury Directorate) within the Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty as the competent foreign-exchange administration; Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) as the banking and financial-licensing supervisor.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible and no exchange-control approval is required for current-account or capital-account transactions. EU free movement of capital under TFEU Articles 63–66 applies, subject only to public-policy safeguarding measures. Profit remittances by an SARL to non-resident shareholders are unrestricted from an FX-convertibility standpoint; the sole practical hurdles are documentary (proof of source of funds and of the corporate resolution authorising distribution) and fiscal (outbound dividend payments are subject to a 30% withholding base comprising 12.8% income tax withholding and 17.2% social levies, reducible under an applicable double-tax treaty). No distinction is made in France between current-account and capital-account convertibility: both are fully liberalised.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no statutory surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation timeline for export proceeds. Exporters may lawfully retain foreign-currency receipts in resident or non-resident bank accounts. The only binding statutory requirement is balance-of-payments statistical reporting: all cross-border payments of EUR 15,000 or more must be reported by the French intermediary bank to the Banque de France on the monthly monetary-flow declaration. The exporter must also maintain auditable commercial evidence supporting each receivable and, under anti-money-laundering rules, be able to demonstrate the origin of any EUR 15,000+ inbound wire.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account in EUR and segregated Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account in EUR and segregated Capital Escrow Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability as the primary treasury infrastructure and Medium feasibility as a supplementary payment rail. ACPR-licensed electronic-money institutions (EMIs) may open passported EU/EEA IBANs but cannot take deposits, cannot grant credit, cannot issue cheques, and are statutorily barred from operating segregated escrow or custody accounts. An EMI is therefore suitable only for routine euro disbursements and not for inbound shareholder capital injections, trade-finance facilities, or pharmaceutical freight settlements where the banking partner must evidence a full credit-institution licence.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French tier-one banks uniformly require a physical compliance interview of the SARL's gérant (general manager) and of each authorised signatory, particularly where the majority shareholder or ultimate beneficial owner is non-resident. Entrance interviews may be displaced by videoconference identification under the ACPR's remote-onboarding guidance (Article R.561-5 of the French Monetary and Financial Code), which permits video KYC where the client is subject to enhanced due diligence and where the due-diligence record is retained; nevertheless, practical market conduct for a newly formed SARL is one in-person meeting, notarised registry documentation, and original signature specimens. Non-resident signatories should plan a hybrid protocol: remote video verification plus a branch visit on French territory before the operating account is activated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-identifiable beneficial owner and opacity in the shareholder chain above the SARL; the bank cannot complete the mandatory 'bénéficiaire effectif' register filed at the commercial registry.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Kbis extract from the registre du commerce et des sociétés; certified articles of association; complete share register (registre des mouvements de titres); registered declaration of the effective beneficiary; notarially certified and apostilled identity documents for each natural person under the 1961 Hague Convention; structural ownership chart describing every intermediate legal vehicle; corporate KYC package and bank reference letter from the shareholder's home bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: GDP pharmaceutical freight licence and ANSM authorisation produced without verifiable operating substance; the compliance team questions whether the SARL truly ranks as a licensed GDP logistics entity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ANSM Good Distribution Practice (GDP) authorisation for pharmaceutical products; warehousing and temperature-controlled storage certificates; qualified-person and quality-assurance audit evidence; executed logistics service agreements with principal pharmaceutical supply chains; ISIC 5229 / NAICS 488510 business-scope statement; batch-record and stock-keeping system demonstration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital contribution labelled as a shareholder loan without documented economic rationale, raising disguised-credit and source-of-wealth concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised corporate resolution approving the capital increase; certified contribution release deed; written loan agreement (if any) at arm's-length commercial terms; upstream bank remittance chain statements; legal opinion confirming the transaction is a liberalised direct investment requiring no prior Treasury authorisation; Banque de France monetary-flow declaration filed within the statutory filing window.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity USD/CHF transactions and unnamed end-clients in international freight corridors, triggering sanctions and proliferation-finance screening friction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed GDP freight-forwarding contracts identifying principal, seller, consignee and delivery routes; airway bills and customs declarations; sub-carrier agreements; sanctions and PEP screening reports for every counterparty against EU consolidated lists; written internal AML risk assessment of the SARL under Article R.561-15 of the French Monetary and Financial Code.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound shareholder capital is routed via SWIFT MT103 wire transfer in EUR through the TARGET2 settlement system, with full field identification (50F ORDERING CUSTOMER, 57A ACCOUNT WITH INSTITUTION, 59 BENEFICIARY CUSTOMER) and a remittance narrative quoting the shareholders' resolution date and the wording 'AUGMENTATION DE CAPITAL – SOCIÉTÉ À RESPONSABILITÉ LIMITÉE'. The flow is classified for French statistical purposes as Direct Investment – Equity Capital and must appear on the Banque de France monthly monetary-flow declaration where the amount equals or exceeds EUR 15,000. Upon credit, funds remain subject to the bank's account-blocking instruction until the SARL supplies the certified resolution and the validated identity pack; after release they are held either in the operating account or in the segregated capital-escrow account consistent with the bank's covenant.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Euro-denominated trade settlements use SEPA Credit Transfer (Direct ACH equivalent), which provides fast clearing among EEA institutions and requires only IBAN and BIC. Disbursements to non-EEA pharmaceutical principals and logistics counterparties are executed by SWIFT MT103 cover payments; where the counterparty mandates secured payment terms, commercial documentary Letters of Credit issued by the SARL's French bank via SWIFT MT700, and documentary collections under SWIFT MT400/MT740, are permissible. Each disbursement must be invoice-matched and backed by the GDP freight documentation, with all payments retaining the beneficiary bank's sanctions screens and the Banque de France reporting trail intact.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable EUR/USD, EUR/CHF, and EUR/GBP forward contracts executed with a French credit institution, requiring a documented underlying trade receivable or payable to qualify for hedge accounting

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on emerging-market currency corridors (e.g., USD/INR, USD/CNY) cash-settled in EUR or USD, permitted for commercial freight flows when supported by bank-approved underlying exposure documentation and within the ACPR derivatives framework

Cross-currency swaps and longer-dated EUR/USD basis swaps used to hedge the refinancing of SARL working-capital or trade-finance facilities, restricted to genuine economic hedging of firm commercial commitments and prohibited from speculative or leveraged structuring

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements and Statutory Reports (Dépôt des comptes annuels, annexes, auditor's report if appointed)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via INPI Guichet Unique des Formalités
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months from financial year-end (calendar-year entity: by 30 June of the following year; court president may grant extension only when an application is filed before expiration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalty per year of late filing; judicial order for compulsory filing under astreinte; risk of administrative strike-off after two consecutive years of non-filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Return (Liasse fiscale – n° 2065-SD and attachments)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), Service des Impôts des Entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year-end entities: the 2nd business day following 1 May of the subsequent fiscal year. For non-calendar year-ends: within three months after closing.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% of net assessed tax (increased to 40% for mere refusal, 80% for fraud or abuse); monthly late payment interest of 0.20%. Interest and penalties are serial until the filing is received.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial-owner Update Declaration (Déclaration de mise à jour des bénéficiaires effectifs) upon share transfer affecting UBO composition
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via INPI Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any shareholding transfer that changes the identification of natural-person beneficial owners. No annual submission is required of unchanged SARL UBO data.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal penalties up to 6 months' imprisonment and €37,500 fine for intentional failure to notify; administrative penalty of €15,000 for incomplete or inexact declaration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (Commissaire aux Comptes) is mandatory if, at the close of a fiscal year, the SARL exceeds two of the three thresholds: balance sheet gross total €4,000,000; net turnover excluding VAT €8,000,000; average number of full-time employees 50. The requirement applies for the fifth consecutive year of threshold excess. A voluntary appointment is allowed in any SARL without legal thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, PCG) and code de commerce accounting rules; IFRS is not permitted for standalone SARL non-listed statutory accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: French law requires a complete UBO declaration at incorporation and a section 30 days of any shareholding transfer that alters the control structure. The annual accounts filing to the Greffe serves as the de facto annual continuity confirmation; no separate annual UBO recertification is required.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Minutes and Deliberations (Registre des procès-verbaux des assemblées)
Register of Manager's Decisions (Registre des décisions du gérant)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$ 600 – US$ 2,500 (registered-office and corporate-secretarial service market for a Paris/Ile-de-France SARL; lower rates in metropolitan France)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$ 5,000 – US$ 15,000 (estimated market fee for a mid-sized GDP pharma-logistics SARL if statutory audit is required after thresholds are exceeded; small SARLs below thresholds normally incur no audit fee)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard corporate income tax (IS); 15% reduced rate on the first EUR 42,000 of taxable profit for eligible SARL SMEs with fully paid-up capital and consolidated turnover below EUR 10 million
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% IS rate for SMEs; Research Tax Credit (CIR) at 30% on eligible R&D up to EUR 100 million; Innovation Tax Credit (CII) at 20% for SMEs; no special or preferential pharma freight logistics tax holiday; statutory surcharge of 3% on IS above EUR 763,000 excluding exempt small entities
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited carryforward under Article 209 CGI; annual offset capped at EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable profit exceeding that amount

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Cerfa 2065-SD (liasse fiscale) with annex forms 2050 through 2059-FC; mandatory electronic filing through impots.gouv.fr via EFI/EDI-TDFC or a certified EDI partner
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For fiscal year ending 31 December: file by the second working day after 1 May. For non-calendar year-ends: within three months of the fiscal year close, generally by the second working day after the end of that three-month period

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A - Identification and tax regime
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Business name, SIREN number, legal form, elected IS regime (standard 25% or reduced 15%) and any group integration position under Article 223 A
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders electing treaty relief must ensure the SARL itself files as a French tax resident; foreign-owned SARLs must include the name, residence country, and address of each non-resident shareholder in the accompanying annual questionnaire

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after statutory deductions and reconciling accounting profit to taxable basis on Form 2058
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only French-source income attributable to the SARL's own activity or to a permanent establishment should be posted; treaty non-resident shareholders cannot offset foreign losses against French profit

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Carryforward losses from prior years and the amount applied in the current year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Unlimited in time but statutorily capped annually; non-resident owners must retain audited supporting schedules to substantiate the loss history

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box K - Reductions et crédits d'impôt
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax reductions and credits including CIR, CII, employment, local investment, and charitable deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credits must relate to activities carried out through the French entity or PE; attach Form 2069-RCI for each credit claimed

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box T - Contribution sociale sur l'IS
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 3% social surcharge applied to corporate income tax above EUR 763,000 in the same year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Evaluate PE-specific thresholds; no exemption for non-resident shareholding unless the company falls within recognised statutory exempt categories

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual declaration of beneficial owners, residence, and share percentages for French reporting of non-resident dividends
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Applies to every non-resident direct or indirect shareholder; must be filed with the 2065-SD and must match the TRC produced for treaty reduced withholding

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a 10% penalty on the tax due plus 0.20% monthly late-payment interest (intérêt de retard). Deliberate under-declaration increases the main penalty to 40%; completes concealment raises it to 80%. Criminal referral for non-filing may also expose the gérant to independent fines and imprisonment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% statutory withholding on dividends paid to non-resident corporate shareholders; for non-resident individuals, a dual-layer final levy generally totals 30% unless treaty impresses reduced treatment
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The beneficial non-resident shareholder must obtain a tax residence certificate (attestation de résidence fiscale / TRC) from its home-state tax authority, then submit the completed French form 5000 (or the relevant treaty-specific form) through the DGFIP portal before the payment date. The paying French SARL must retain the certified copy in its accounting records to apply the reduced treaty rate in lieu of the 25% domestic withholding.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties and licence fees for patents and intellectual property: statutory withholding 33.33% under Article 182 A CGI; treaty rates generally reduced to 0-10% according to the relevant DTA. Interest on ordinary commercial debt: domestic law imposes no general withholding tax, except for interest paid to entities in tax havens under Article 212 (payer liable for a 28% or 75% penalty); treaty rates on conventional bank/loan interest are commonly 0%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Master File and Local File documentation arises when the French entity's turnover excluding tax or total gross assets reaches EUR 50 million, or when the parent group's consolidated turnover or assets reach EUR 400 million (Article L.13 AA CGI); failure to file transfers burden of proof and may trigger procedural fines
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France has no formal Economic Substance Regulations akin to UAE or BVI, but applies a substantive anti-abuse doctrine through abuse of rights (abus de droit), artificial construction, and BEPS Action 5 minimum standards. A letterbox SARL without actual premises, pharma freight operations, licensed GDP warehouse capacity, or operational control over transport flows can be re-characterized as a sham, resulting in full income recasting and denial of treaty benefits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willful omission of taxable revenue, statement of fictitious costs, backdated freight invoices, or failure to file the 2065-SD liasse fiscale in order to reduce French corporate tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal sanction under Article 1741 CGI: imprisonment up to five years and fine up to EUR 75,000; civil penalty: 40% for deliberate intent, 80% for concealment, plus 0.20% monthly late interest
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Gérant or directors who authorised the fraudulent filing are jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax debt; travel restrictions, bank seizure, and personal restitution orders may be imposed; in insolvency, judicial officers can pursue the management personally for the whole passif.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Uses a facade SARL without real employees, without lease over GDP-compliant warehousing, without temperature-registered freight capacity, or with identical registered address for many unrelated non-resident owners
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGFIP re-characterization as an artificial entity; disallowance of deductions, full profit reallocation to foreign parent, VAT recovery refusal, DTA benefit denial, and levy of penalties for undisclosed tax relief
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Veil piercing for fictitious single-purpose companies is admitted; the managing director can be ordered to pay all unpaid corporate taxes and debts arising from unlawful invoicing and GDP licence non-compliance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Acting as certified GDP freight forwarder or warehousing logisitics provider without the mandatory French National Agency for Medicines and Health Products Safety (ANSM) authorisation, or handling falsified medicines in and out of France
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative: revocation of GDP authorisation, seizure of pharma stock, product recall; criminal sanction under the Public Health Code: up to two years imprisonment and fine up to EUR 300,000 for distribution of falsified medicinal products
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Executive imprisonment, extension of disqualification orders to other regulated activities, forced closure of premises, and personal liability for compensation in supply-chain damage actions

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Missing arm's-length margin on cross-border related-party pharma freight transactions, absence of TP documentation despite threshold exposure, or artificially placing profit offshore without French substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment by DGFIP with tax and social debt recalculated, 0.20% monthly interest, 40% deliberate mispricing penalty, and reversal of burden of proof; refusal to provide TP documentation may trigger procedural fines and additional assessments
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who certify false TP documentation are exposed to criminal fraud penalties, civil liability to co-shareholders and creditors, and professional disqualification from serving as a SARL manager in any French entity.
